purpose: Prove failure and policy-denial recording locally: three distinct failure receipts cover a retryable system error, a non-retryable policy denial, and a failure requiring human review, each carrying attempted action, actor, authority basis, source evidence refs, retry allowance, failure code, result, and human-review-required flag. For the policy denial, the affected Work Item remains in a reviewable state group and the denial rationale traces to specific policy flags plus evidence references that resolve within the slice. Failure codes are declared as a Story 2.6 local extension of the manifest's free-text com_failure_code column. No tenant writes occur; any live Work Item state move stays receipt-gated to Epic 2 Story 2.3.

failureCodeVocabulary.basis: Manifest com_councilreceipt.com_failure_code is a free-text column with no enumerated choice set, so this slice declares a Story 2.6 local extension naming the failure codes used here together with their kind, retry allowance, and human-review semantics. Codes are reproducible local-contract identifiers, not tenant enums; adopting them as tenant-wide choice values is a deferred, receipt-gated decision for Epic 2.

codes.definition: An attempted source read could not complete because of a transient system error (for example, a connector timeout or throttled Graph call). The action may be retried under a new receipt; no human review is required for the retry gate.

Auto-creation policy denied creating or auto-approving a Work Item because the candidate failed a risk or approval threshold (for example, mock/manual evidence with no authorized source body). The affected Work Item stays in a reviewable state group and the denial is non-retryable without a policy change.

Extraction could not reach sufficient confidence to either propose or ignore a candidate; the outcome is held for human review before any state move, and the affected Work Item stays reviewable until cleared.

failureReceipts.com_authority_basis: local non-tenant Story 2.6 contract validation; attempted source read is receipt-gated and not authorized against a live tenant
failureReceipts.attemptedAction: Read CSR-OUTLOOK-MESSAGE-MOCK-001 from the mock Outlook connector to refresh its captured snapshot for extraction review.
failureReceipts.com_decision_rationale: The mock Outlook connector returned a transient timeout on the read attempt. This is a retryable system error, not a policy denial; the source record stays hash-only and no Work Item state changed. A retry may be attempted later under a new receipt gated to Epic 2.

failureReceipts.com_authority_basis: local non-tenant Story 2.6 contract validation; auto-creation policy is evaluated locally and any live denial write is receipt-gated to Epic 2
failureReceipts.attemptedAction: Auto-create and auto-approve CWI-LOCAL-FOLLOWUP-001 from CSR-OUTLOOK-MESSAGE-MOCK-001 without human approval.
failureReceipts.com_decision_rationale: Auto-creation policy denied auto-approving the follow-up because its primary source is mock/manual, hash-only evidence with no authorized source body, and low-risk follow-ups still require human approval before any external action. The denial is non-retryable without a policy change. The affected Work Item remains proposed (a reviewable state group) so Doug can still review, hold, or reassign it; no state changed in this slice.
failureReceipts.com_policy_flags: local_contract_evidence_only; no_tenant_write; no_outbound_action; policy_denied; auto_create_policy_denied; mock_manual_not_tenant_verified; source_body_not_stored; human_approval_required

failureReceipts.com_authority_basis: local non-tenant Story 2.6 contract validation; extraction confidence is evaluated locally and any live hold write is receipt-gated to Epic 2
failureReceipts.attemptedAction: Extract a confident decision candidate from CSR-MANUAL-MEETING-001 for CWI-LOCAL-DECISION-002 without human review.
failureReceipts.com_decision_rationale: Extraction could not reach sufficient confidence to either promote or ignore the deferral decision candidate: the meeting summary is pending ratification and the sample does not state who holds final decision authority. This is a failure requiring human review, not a policy denial; the affected Work Item stays proposed (a reviewable state group) and no state changed in this slice. The item is held for human review until a reviewer clears the uncertainty.

policyDenialTrace.denialRationale: Auto-creation policy denied auto-approving the follow-up because its primary source is mock/manual, hash-only evidence with no authorized source body, and low-risk follow-ups still require human approval before any external action.

affectedWorkItems.note: The policy-denied follow-up stays proposed (a reviewable state group) so Doug can still review, hold, or reassign it; no state changed in this slice.
The uncertain extraction candidate stays proposed (a reviewable state group) and is held for human review; no state changed in this slice.

workItemStateChangesDeferred.deferredUpdate: Any com_state_group move driven by the policy denial (for example proposed to blocked or held) requires a new receipt-backed mutation gated to Epic 2 Story 2.3; this slice records the denial only and performs no state change.

Any com_state_group move driven by the human-review failure (for example proposed to in_review) requires a new receipt-backed mutation gated to Epic 2 Story 2.3; this slice records the review-required flag only and performs no state change.
